risk_if_not_implemented: Without Deactivated Account Activity, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_1.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Deactivated Account Activity (MON-17.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Monitoring Reporting
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to provide an event log report generation capability to aid in detecting and assessing anomalous activities.
